# Hermey

> A native iOS and macOS client for your own Hermes agent, plus the one command that installs its
> host-side service. No account, no cloud in the middle: the apps talk to a loopback service on the
> user's own machine, exposed over their tailnet with a real certificate.

The repo is a client, not a server. Installation is: run one shell command as root on the Hermes host,
then install the app on a phone or Mac and pair it with a short code.

## Install

- Host (root, on a machine already running Hermes):
  `curl -fsSL https://github.com/macblizzard/hermey/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sudo sh`
  It downloads the `hermeyd` binary for the platform, verifies the published SHA-256, installs it
  under `/opt/hermey/bin`, and writes `/var/lib/hermeyd`, `/etc/hermey/hermeyd.env` and the unit.
  `latest` means the newest `hermeyd-v*` release; the apps' own `v0.1.N` releases carry no host
  binary. `--from-source` builds with cargo instead.
- Then: `hermeyd pair` — prints a 6-digit code, `https://<host>/?code=…` and a QR for the app
  (`POST /v1/pair/start` is the same route).
- Publishing: the installer runs `tailscale serve --bg http://127.0.0.1:8788` itself — serve-root, no
  `:8443` — and prints a pairing URL. `--no-serve` skips it; a missing or logged-out `tailscale`
  leaves the one command to run.
- iOS: add `https://github.com/macblizzard/hermey/releases/latest/download/altstore.json` to
  AltStore or SideStore.
- macOS: `Hermey-macOS-<version>.dmg` from <https://macblizzard.github.io/hermey-downloads/> (the
  versioned name is the newest build; `Hermey-macOS-unsigned.dmg` on the same page is the same bytes
  under the older name). Right-click → Open on first launch, or
  `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Hermey.app`.

## Agent runbook

- [docs/FOR-AGENTS.md](docs/FOR-AGENTS.md): the installation procedure written for an agent to
  execute — preflight, install, verification gates, pairing, hard rules, failure playbook.

## Reference

- [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md): installer flags, environment variables, paths on disk, uninstall.
- [docs/APPS.md](docs/APPS.md): iOS and macOS installation, first run, unpairing and revocation.
- [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): symptom, cause, fix, with real log strings.
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): how `hermeyd` relays the engine's WebSocket; the protocol.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): threat model, what is and is not protected, reporting a vulnerability.
- [docs/CREDENTIALS.md](docs/CREDENTIALS.md): login cards — a bot signs in without ever seeing the secret.
- [docs/agent-cards.md](docs/agent-cards.md): agent cards — `::card` + `card.v1`, three kinds (approval, task, draft-email), and the rule that a question with options is always a card.
- [setup/SKILL.md](setup/SKILL.md): the same install packaged as a Hermes agent skill.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): build, test and release from source.

## Facts a tool needs

- Host service: **hermeyd** — main API on `127.0.0.1:8788`, browser channel on `127.0.0.1:8790`.
  Loopback only; `GET /v1/health` answers `{"status":"ok","protocol_version":…,"ws":true}` with no credential.
- Credential: every other `/v1` route requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, read from
  `<state>/local.token` (mode `0600`, state dir `$HERMEY_HOME` or `~/.hermey`). The service mints it
  on boot.
  `HERMEYD_LOCAL_TOKEN` / `HERMEYD_LOCAL_TOKEN_FILE` override the value and the path.
- Tailnet front door: `tailscale serve --bg http://127.0.0.1:8788` — serve-root, so pairing URLs carry
  no port (real certificate; the apps refuse self-signed).
- Units: `hermeyd.service` (Linux) or `com.hermeyd` (macOS launchd).
- Engine: `HERMEYD_ENGINE_HOME` (contains `profiles/`), `HERMEYD_ENGINE_WS` (default
  `ws://127.0.0.1:9121/api/ws`), `HERMEYD_ENGINE_TOKEN_FILE`. Start it with `hermes serve --isolated`:
  one gateway per `HERMES_HOME`. `hermeyd --gateway-check` exits 75 on a duplicate.
- Plugin: `hermes-genui` ships with this repo and is installed into `<engine>/plugins/hermes-genui`;
  upstream Hermes does not have it, and cards answer 503 without it.
- Requirements: Linux with systemd or macOS, Hermes installed, the service account sharing the
  engine's UID, Tailscale (or your own TLS proxy).
- Versions: the apps are `0.1.<run>` (tag `v0.1.N`); `hermeyd` has its own series
  (`hermeyd-vX.Y.Z`) and moves only when `hermeyd/src/` or its bundled skills change. A client
  release does not bump it; CI enforces that.
- Apps: iOS 17+, macOS 14+, unsigned builds (AltStore/SideStore, or right-click → Open). Images in a
  message open as a gallery that pages through every attachment on that message. iOS also shows a
  running turn as a Live Activity (lock screen + Dynamic Island).
